q: Give the cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
Bring 8 Gnoll Paws to Captain Danuvin on Sentinel Hill.
Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.
Bring 10 Spotted Sunfish to Dockmaster Baren in Lakeshire.
Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
Gather 10 Atal'ai Tablets for Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.
Bring the Faded Shadowhide Pendant to Theocritus the Mage.
Bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
Kill Edwin VanCleef and bring his head to Gryan Stoutmantle.
Kill 12 Kobold Laborers, then return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
Bring the Grape Manifest to Brother Neals in Northshire Abbey.
Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.
Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
Apothecary Johaan of the town of Brill needs 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in Tirisfal Glades.
Take the Woven Wand to Bethor Iceshard in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
Farmer Saldean wants you to kill 20 Harvest Watchers.
Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
Escort Mist to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
Bring 10 vials of Mountain Lion Blood to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
Retrieve a Fallen Moonstone from the Shadethicket Oracle, then bring it to Pelturas in Astranaar.
Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
Bring Leftwitch's Package back to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.
Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
Steal Tazan's key, then use it to open his Satchel and deliver its contents to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.
Deliver Andron's Ledger to Varimathras in the Hall of the Dark Lady in the Undercity.
Find the Defias Dockmaster and recover the Shipping Schedule for Master Mathias Shaw.
Take Onin's Report back to Hulfdan in Ironforge.
Find Sethir the Ancient and bring back any clues that you may discover to Syurna.
Speak with Tabetha after her ritual.
Travel to the Venture Co. Tower, north of the Sludge Fen and contact the Shattered Hand's covert operative, Taskmaster Fizzule.
Read Baelog's Journal, explore the hidden chamber, then report to Prospector Stormpike.
Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
Wait for Trenton to finish his work.
Bring the Nightmare Shard to Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise.
Bring the Nightmare Shard to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

Destroy Razelikh the Defiler and return the Severed Horn of the Defiler to the Fallen Hero of the Horde. You will also need to return the Ward of the Defiler so that the Fallen Hero can destroy it, preventing it from ever falling into the wrong hands.
Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.
Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Using the contents of Torwa's Pouch, summon Lar'korwi and defeat him. Then bring Lar'korwi's Head to Torwa Pathfinder near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater.
Bring U'cha's Pelt to Torwa Pathfinder at the entrance of Un'Goro Crater.
A Little Slime Goes a Long Way
Bring 10 Filled Pure Sample Jars to Laris Geardawdle in Ironforge.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments and be rewarded for each one you turn in.
Bring Kum'isha Imperfect Draenethyst Fragments. Any form of monster in the Blasted Lands could be carrying a fragment.
Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city. Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Locate 5 Andorhal Watches amongst the rubble of the city, and return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.
Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.
Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.

Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them. Sickly Deer have been reported starting south of the Cliffspring River to the north of Auberdine and extending all the way into southern Darkshore

Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Gazelles that are located throughout the northern part of the Barrens; doing so should cure them. Sickly Gazelles have been reported north of the east-west road that runs through the Crossroads.
Escort Taelan Fordring out of Hearthglen.
Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller.
Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.
Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.
Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Belt
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Arygos in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring him Imperial Qiraji Armaments and 3 Elementium Ore.

Report to Krug Skullsplit at the Orgrimmar Legion post in front of Hive'Regal. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers, obtain Signed Field Duty Papers and bring them to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold.

Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 Powerful Anti-Venom and 4 Smoked Desert Dumplings to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing I in order to complete this quest.
Bring 3 Ornate Mithril Boots to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing II in order to complete this quest.

Bring 10 Dense Grinding Stones, 10 Solid Grinding Stones and 10 Heavy Grinding Stones to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing III in order to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Mooncloth, 2 Bolts of Runecloth and 1 Ironweb Spider Silk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.
Bring 2 Enchanted Thorium Bars and 2 Enchanted Leather to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IX in order to complete this quest.
Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Clay Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 6 Powerful Mojo, 6 Flasks of Big Mojo and 8 Oils of Immolation to Shadow Priestess Shai near Hive'Regal in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.
Bring 3 Massive Iron Axes to Merok Longstride at the Orgrimmar Legion camp outside of Hive'Regal. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.
Bring 8 Rugged Armor Kits and 8 Heavy Armor Kits to Merok Longstride near Hive'Regal. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing VII in order to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard, 1 Large Radiant Shard and 1 Huge Emerald to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2 Lambent Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Deliver the Head of Ossirian the Unscarred to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Slay Nefarian and recover the Red Scepter Shard. Return the Red Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. You have 5 hours to complete this task.
Bring a Beaststalker's Belt and a set of Beaststalker's Gloves to Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Beaststalker's Belt and a set of Beaststalker's Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Devout Sandals, Devout Skirt and Devout Mantle.
Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves Deliana in Ironforge.
Bring a Wildheart Belt and a set of Wildheart Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.

Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreadnaught Helmet if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Helmet, 15 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 5 Arcanite Bars and 1 Nexus Crystal.

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.

Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make an Earthshatter Headpiece if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Headpiece if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Circlet of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Circlet, 15 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 3 Nexus Crystals.

Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 2 Essences of Water, 4 Ironweb Spider Silks and 200 gold. You must also be of Exalted reputation with the Argent Dawn.
